Token Metadata: Expiration time and token type
Authorization Header: Token used in "Authorization: Bearer {token}" format
User Interface: User information displayed in dashboard headers
Access Control: Permissions used to enable/disable UI features

member.name: P:LoginResponseDto.Token
member.summary: JWT bearer token for API authentication

remarks.para: Secure JSON Web Token containing user claims and permissions.
Format: Base64-encoded JWT with header.payload.signature structure
Usage: Include in Authorization header as "Bearer {token}"
Security: Signed with server secret key and includes expiration

member.name: P:LoginResponseDto.TokenType
member.summary: Token type identifier (always "Bearer")

remarks.para: Standard OAuth 2.0 token type designation.
RFC Compliance: Follows RFC 6750 Bearer Token specification
Client Implementation: Used to construct proper Authorization header

member.name: P:LoginResponseDto.ExpiresAt
member.summary: Token expiration timestamp (UTC)

remarks.para: Absolute expiration time for the JWT token in UTC timezone.
Client Usage: Monitor for token refresh or re-authentication needs
Security: Tokens automatically invalid after this time
Format: ISO 8601 DateTime format

member.name: P:LoginResponseDto.User
member.summary: Authenticated user information and permissions

remarks.para: Complete user context including role, permissions, and access rights.
Purpose: Enables client-side authorization and UI customization
Contents: Username, role, display name, counties, sites, and permissions

member.name: T:UserInfoDto
member.summary: User information data transfer object for authenticated user context

remarks.para: This DTO provides comprehensive user information for client-side authorization and UI customization.

item.description: CEO: Full system access, all counties and sites
Regional: Access to specific counties and their sites
Operator: Limited access to assigned sites only
Counties: Romanian administrative regions (Prahova, Gorj, etc.)
Sites: Individual industrial monitoring locations
Dynamic Access: Permissions can be updated without re-authentication

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.Username
member.summary: Unique username identifier

remarks.para: The user's login identifier within the monitoring system.
Format: Often includes role and location context (e.g., "operator.prahova")
Uniqueness: Must be unique across the entire system

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.Role
member.summary: User role designation (CEO, Regional, Operator)

remarks.para: Primary role-based access control designation.
CEO: Executive level access to all system resources
Regional: Regional manager access to assigned counties
Operator: Field operator access to specific monitoring sites

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.DisplayName
member.summary: Human-readable display name for user interface

remarks.para: Friendly name displayed in user interface elements.
Format: Typically "First Last" or "Role Title"
Usage: Dashboard headers, welcome messages, and user menus

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.AllowedCounties
member.summary: Romanian counties this user is authorized to access

remarks.para: List of Romanian administrative counties where user has monitoring access.
Examples: ["Prahova", "Gorj", "Buzau"]
Usage: Filter county maps and site lists
CEO Access: Empty list typically means access to all counties

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.AllowedSites
member.summary: Monitoring site IDs this user is authorized to access

remarks.para: Specific site identifiers where user has monitoring privileges.
Examples: [1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9, 10] for Prahova county sites
Usage: Filter site dashboards and sensor data
CEO Access: Empty list typically means access to all sites

member.name: P:UserInfoDto.Permissions
member.summary: Specific system permissions for fine-grained access control

remarks.para: Granular permissions beyond role-based access control.

item.description: ManageConfiguration: Update site layouts and sensor positions
